INSERT INTO group_link_preview ( group_link_id, invite_code, wa_subject, avatar_url, last_preview_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{groupLinkId}, #{inviteCode}, #{waSubject}, #{avatarUrl}, #{lastPreviewAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE invite_code = CASE WHEN invite_code_observed_at IS NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(invite_code)), ''), invite_code) ELSE invite_code END, wa_subject = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(wa_subject)), ''), wa_subject), avatar_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(avatar_url)), ''), avatar_url), last_preview_at = CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(wa_subject)), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(avatar_url)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN VALUES(last_preview_at) ELSE last_preview_at END, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
